# Repository Instructions

This repository powers the public GitHub profile for Kiliaan Vanvoorden
(`BoozeLee`). Keep it concise, accurate, and employment-focused.

## Editing Guidelines

- Prefer clear, verifiable claims over inflated metrics.
- Link only to public repositories that are working, documented, or explicitly
  useful as portfolio evidence.
- Do not add payment setup notes, private contact details, or obsolete
  organization links.
- Keep Markdown portable and readable on GitHub mobile and desktop.

## Validation

There is no build step. Before committing, review `README.md` rendered in
GitHub-flavored Markdown and check links to public repositories manually.
